The platform · v6

## The foundation changed. So everything got better.

V6 is the rebuilt core that will power Voice AI, Chat AI, Employee AI, Orbit, and Assemble. The knowledge your AI agent uses on the phone is the same knowledge it uses in chat. Changes made within one channel can update across all. Your compliance team audits one trail - not four separate logs.

### One shared engine

V6 is the rebuilt core powering Voice AI today, with Chat AI and Employee AI coming soon. One engine, one knowledge source - one answer on every channel.

### Self-service control

A self-service admin console for knowledge, agents, routing, and config. Your team manages day-to-day changes directly, no code, no tickets.

### Governance & audit

Change-approval workflows for bot and environment configs, plus an immutable audit log, are built in.

### Reliability

Reliability-first architecture with multi-region LLM failover and primary/secondary STT/TTS designed to switch over automatically.

Grounded answers · v6

### Precision answers, not approximations.

V6 doesn't guess from text snippets. It extracts actual facts and real rate/fee tables from your content, then reads the exact row. Ask "what's the 12-month CD APY at $10k?" and the member gets the real number from your rate schedule, with a citation back to the source.

JR

What's the 12-month CD APY at $10,000?

![](https://uat.interface.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/bot-smiling.png)

Your 12-month Certificate at $10,000 earns **4.35% APY**. Rates are accurate as of today's published schedule.


Rate-Schedule-2026.pdf · Table 2, row 4

#### Upload your sources

URLs, PDF, Word, HTML/web pages, and more. Plus SharePoint content.

#### Every answer has a receipt

Citations point to the PDF page, table row, slide, or webpage section. Supervisors verify any answer in seconds.

#### Honesty built in

When confidence is low, it's designed to refuse rather than guess. … It's built to ground every answer in your sources, with a citation.

Assemble · v6

## You're in control

Assemble is the new unified administration portal for building, running, and shipping your AI agents - for the configurators who shape conversations, the IT admins who manage environments, and the operators who run dashboards. Your team makes the changes, no tickets, no waiting.

![Assemble Voice AI events and messaging](https://uat.interface.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/assemble-shot-3.png)

![Assemble knowledge sources](https://uat.interface.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/assemble-shot-1.png)

![Assemble conversations dashboard](https://uat.interface.ai/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/assemble-shot-2.png)

Before

Submit a ticket. Wait for interface.ai. Hope it ships this sprint.

After

Make the change yourself in 60 seconds, with an approval trail.

#### Change management & version control

Save, review, and deploy on your own timeline. Every change has an approval workflow. Roll back or promote versions, governance baked in, not bolted on.

#### Transfer routing & events

Define routing topics, queues, schedules, and event calendars from one interface. Map conversational context to queues, all without a ticket.

#### Enhanced knowledge management

Configure pronunciations, add reference links for topics, and manage the knowledge entities extracted from your documents and URLs, all in one place.

#### Persona configuration

Modify the name, voice, and personality of your AI Assistant to align perfectly with your institution's brand.

#### Product specific configuration

Configure how each product behaves by easily assigning distinct personas, setting default messages, and tailoring the user experience.

#### Environment specific configuration

Set up separate configurations between UAT and Production environments. Safely test and roll out changes during internal testing without ever impacting your live production setup.

#### Multi-language support

Configure global messages in multiple languages with optional auto-translation for institutions serving diverse member communities.

#### Analytics & insights

Prove what your AI is worth and see exactly what it's doing. Purpose-built dashboards turn every conversation into operational intelligence, automation rate, deflection, sentiment, trending topics, and dollar-based ROI, all real-time and in-app.

### Single sign-on

Day-1 SSO, no new password to remember. Assemble authenticates through your existing identity provider, so your team signs in with the credentials they already use, with roles and access governed centrally.

**SSO via your existing IdP:** Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Okta, and more.

**SCIM:** Automated or just-in-time provisioning.

**Audited:** All user activities are fully logged for compliance purposes.

### Test Studio

Ship changes with confidence. Automated regression and scenario testing, built into Assemble, validates transactional flows and knowledge accuracy before anything reaches a member. Deploy because you've already seen it pass, not because you crossed your fingers.

Voice AI · AIPB · v6

## Your Voice AI Agent can do even more. A lot more

V6 brings a fundamentally smarter conversational engine to Voice AI, one that understands what members actually mean, remembers what they've said, and handles more transactions end-to-end without ever touching an agent queue. This isn't a feature update. It's a different category of Voice AI Agent.

Conversations that thinkNew TransactionsIntelligence & routingExperience ScoreQuality assuranceReliability

Your Voice AI Agent used to follow scripts. In V6, it follows conversations.

Most Voice AI Agent break the moment a member goes off-script, balance, then paying off a loan early, then refinancing rates, and the old system loses the thread. V6 doesn't. It holds the full context of every conversation, adapts in real time, and responds to what the member actually said, not the menu option they were closest to. The result: more calls resolved without transfers, fewer "I'm sorry, I didn't understand that," and members who feel known.

### AI-driven dynamic conversational flows

V6 handles natural, multi-step conversations that evolve in real time based on what the member says, not what a decision tree anticipated.

- Understands member intent dynamically, even as it shifts mid-call
- Chains multiple transactions in one conversation without losing context
- Handles follow-ups naturally, "what about my savings account?" continues the call

### Advanced context handling

V6 remembers everything said in a conversation, and uses it. Ask "can I raise it just while I'm away?" and the bot knows "it" is the card limit, knows the member is traveling, and routes correctly.

- Maintains a running understanding of intent across every turn
- Adjusts authentication intelligently to transaction risk and what's confirmed
- Passes full context to agents on warm transfer, no re-explaining

#### Multi-membership support

Manage multiple memberships in a single call. The Voice AI Agent tracks which membership is in context at each moment.

#### Member-to-member transfers

Transfer funds to other members in the same credit union, verification, confirmation, and execution, no agent.

#### Loan payments via ACH

Pay loans from external accounts (SWBC). The Voice AI Agent guides the full flow and confirms completion in the same call.

#### Account & member number retrieval

Retrieve account or member numbers on demand, identity confirmed, information delivered securely.

#### Card controls (Velera / PSCU)

Activate cards, report lost or stolen, flag fraud, and troubleshoot, credit and debit, with sentiment guardrails.

#### Pending transactions & check verification

Real-time visibility into pending deposits and withdrawals, plus instant verification of money orders and checks.

### Friction by influence

V6 dynamically decides whether to resolve in the conversation or escalate to a live agent, fewer unnecessary transfers, while complex issues reach the right person faster.

### GenAI-driven dynamic routing

Conversations are routed on real-time intent understanding, not rigid menu trees. The bot adapts to what the member actually says.

### Next-best-action prompts

The AI anticipates what the member is likely to need next and surfaces the right action at the right moment.

### A smarter way to measure Voice AI Agent performance.

Every conversation gets an AI-generated score across three dimensions. Unlike surveys, which skew negative, have low response rates, and suffer recall bias, Experience Score captures 100% of interactions, adjusts for bias automatically, and enables real-time, data-driven CX improvement.

Goal achievement50%

Was the member's objective actually achieved?

Efficiency35%

How quickly and cleanly did we serve them?

Emotional context15%

What was the member's sentiment throughout?

#### Expanded testing coverage

Faster, more reliable product validation before anything reaches members.

#### Strengthened knowledge foundation

Responses come only from trusted, approved sources. No hallucinations, no guessing.

#### End-to-end traceability

Full visibility into data lineage for compliance and confidence.

#### Enhanced performance evaluations

Sharper AI quality insights that improve over time.

### Always-on performance

Built-in redundancy keeps conversations running without interruption. Primary/secondary STT/TTS failover and multi-region LLM fallback that switch without dropping calls.

### Live health visibility

Real-time metrics on latency, accuracy, and uptime, so your team knows the system is working before members notice anything.

Chat AI · Orbit · v6

## The same engine, now in every chat window.

Orbit is coming to the V6 engine this fall, designed so context carries and every answer holds a citation.

Orbit core capabilities

#### A refreshed chat window

A modern interface that feels refreshed and intuitive from the first message.

#### Smarter back-and-forth

Interactions that reduce friction and ask the right follow-up questions, cutting misunderstandings.

#### Less robotic, more engaging

A conversational experience that responds with empathy and awareness, building member trust.

#### Speak, don't type

Voice input lets members talk instead of type, faster and more accessible interactions.

#### Remembers prior inputs

Orbit holds context across the conversation, reducing repetition and frustration.

#### Helpful next-step suggestions

Surfaces the right next action to keep members moving toward resolution.

#### Spanish support

Makes Orbit accessible to Spanish-speaking members out of the box.

#### One source of truth

Chat reads from the same grounded knowledge as every channel, update once in Assemble, live everywhere.

Captures the member experience, conversation by conversation.

#### Your voice, your brand

You write the offer script. Define product, messaging, and CTA. Full creative control, no forced templates.

#### Natural-language targeting

#### Chained next actions

What's next

## This is the foundation. Here's where it goes.

V6 was built to keep improving, for you and by you. Today, your team configures everything in Assemble without writing code or filing tickets. Next, you'll author entirely new capabilities yourself, through the same approval and audit workflow you already trust. These are previews of the direction, more control, faster, in your hands, not commitments to dates.

On the way

### Agent Builder Studio

Author your own intents, no engineer required. Today you choose from our pre-built transactional agents and customize by configuration. Soon, admins will design entirely new use cases in a visual workflow, versioned, audited, and approved through the same review process Knowledge already uses. Time-to-launch drops dramatically faster

On the way

### Tool Builder Studio

Build your own integrations without an engineering ticket. Describe what you need and the system generates the tool, REST, SOAP, MCP, or sandboxed logic. Mandatory sensitivity classification keeps protected data away from the LLM. Test before you deploy, with a full audit trail. Same-day tools, not weeks of engineering.

### Always improving, everywhere at once

Because every product runs on one engine, every improvement we ship lifts your entire platform, chat, voice, and agent-assist together. You don't upgrade four products. You get better continuously, across all of them.

Roadmap items represent direction, not committed delivery dates.
